name: bt2023_WY
_comment: Backtest: fit the 2023-24 season, project 2024-25 out of sample. One continuous run per particle from 2023-08-06; the person file holds only history before that (2021-22/2022-23 campaigns, 2022-23 infections). See escape-flu-smh/py-modules/flu_smh/experiment.py for every field. Transmissibility priors: on the VA network R0 ~ 115 x tau (cryptic-round estimate, ~28 transmissions per tau per infectious-day x ~4.1 infectious-day equivalents), so the peak tau (baseline + seasonal) spans 0.004-0.020 (R0 ~0.5-2.3) and the off-season stays near or below R = 1.
